verdict.rationale: Helicone works as an API-driven gateway, so it can run without a UI. Requests are logged through the OpenAI SDK, a REST query API (curl example) and an OpenAPI spec are documented, outbound webhooks can trigger automated workflows, and self-hosting via Docker Compose is supported. However, nothing in the evidence documents CI pipeline usage or a headless CLI, so this rests on API primitives rather than a documented CI/automation story. Missing for 10: an official CLI, CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), and hands-on reports of headless/CI use.
